after_expected_public_metadata.description:
UNCERTIFIED — no hash-bound Viridis Comparator certificate covers this deposit's claims. Lean sources may compile but have not been independently certified. Results are conditional on the stated model assumptions.

Historical description:

Standalone record of the Viridis Canon (Mutualistic Inference Networks). The core Intelligence-Bound canon spine is unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0 “The Keystone Wave”, record 21223021); this record links to the spine via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982.

We formalize the Mutualistic Inference Network Theorem (MINT), “the Mutualist” — the 27th Intelligence-Bound self-application. MINT lifts the Symbiotic Inference Theorem (SIT, a two-agent result) to an N-agent predictive commons: a network of agents that share partial information about a shared environment, each paying an inference cost and each drawing a synergistic subsidy from the group's redundancy and synergy structure.

Six results are machine-checked in Lean 4 (Aristotle, zero sorry, axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), namespace Viridis.MutualisticInference: (i) mint_network_ledger_no_penalty — the predictive commons never penalizes a participant relative to going it alone; (ii) mint_dyad_recovers_sit — the N=2 floor recovers the certified SIT dyad value exactly (3/2), pinning the network result to prior canon and witnessing non-vacuity; (iii) mint_pid_subsidy_nonneg_le_total — the synergistic subsidy is well-defined and bounded, 0 ≤ S ≤ I_total; (iv) mint_group_markov_blanket_ceiling — an additive group Markov-blanket ceiling; (v) mint_efficiency_eq_cos2_theta — allocation efficiency is a discrete cos²Θ alignment measure in [0,1] via Cauchy–Schwarz; (vi) mint_mutualist_IB_ceiling — the headline result: the group's total information-acquisition rate is Intelligence-Bound-limited, and open, mutual prediction strictly beats solo inference whenever the subsidy is positive.

MINT sits alongside the Universal Water-Filling Meta-Theorem (UWMT) and Geodesic Saturation Theorem (GST), both admitted to spine v10.1.0, as a downstream application of the water-filling/shadow-price machinery to the cognitive-modeling × symbiosis domain, rather than a domain-defining extension itself — hence its standalone (not spine) routing.

Scope. The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
after_expected_public_metadata.notes: Viridis Canon, standalone record (NEW category: Mutualistic Inference Networks; "the Mutualist", 27th Intelligence-Bound self-application). Routed standalone from Nightly Run-085 (2026-07-02); ledger row 42. CONVERGENCE EVENT: lifts the Symbiotic Inference Theorem (SIT, Run-062) dyad result to an N-agent predictive commons. Spine unchanged (frozen at v10.1.0, record 21223021, 'The Keystone Wave'); this record links to the spine only via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982 and references the current spine head. Lean 4 proofs (Aristotle project 71b77385-316c-460d-8255-c87713250db8, task a592bd11-fb71-4bb6-b4ea-15a4819432f8, COMPLETE @100%, completed 2026-07-02T00:13:04Z; zero sorry; #print axioms within {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} for every named theorem; toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, Mathlib pin 8f9d9cff) certify the analytic core of MINT, namespace Viridis.MutualisticInference. The six verified theorems, statements verbatim: (1) mint_network_ledger_no_penalty -- the edge-subsidy ledger (sum Inon) - (sum E Ipred) - sHigher <= sum Inon: the predictive commons never penalizes participants; (2) mint_dyad_recovers_sit -- the N=2 floor equals 2 - 1/2 - 0 = 3/2, exactly the certified SIT dyad floor, pinning the network limit to the prior result and witnessing non-vacuity; (3) mint_pid_subsidy_nonneg_le_total -- partial-information-decomposition atoms nonnegative implies the synergistic subsidy S obeys 0 <= S <= I_total (measure-robust sum identity; the redundancy/synergy split itself is not asserted); (4) mint_group_markov_blanket_ceiling -- additive group ceiling: ceil_j <= sum ceil_i for each positive ceiling; (5) mint_efficiency_eq_cos2_theta -- allocation efficiency eta = (sum a.b)^2 / ((sum a^2)(sum b^2)) in [0,1] via discrete Cauchy-Schwarz, eta=1 iff proportional allocations (Fisher angle Theta=0); (6) mint_mutualist_IB_ceiling -- the 27th IB self-application: sum dI_i <= sum ceil_i, and (sum ceil - subsidy) < sum ceil strictly whenever subsidy>0 -- open science / mutual prediction is a strict thermodynamic improvement over solo inference. All conclusions non-vacuous. Deferred (out of clean core, NOT in this record): legibility_percolation_threshold, per_agent_cost_sublinear, synergy_vanishes (ER mean-field / measure-dependent); water-fill + envelope machinery inherited from UWMT (Run-084, now spine v10.1.0). The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.
